w3Mentions.name: Chorus Line
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🐗 RAID — 3 raiders (The Heckler, Chorus Line, Ugly-Eyes) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! The palisade's stakes take their toll as they come over the wall.

w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Terms of Service.

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: The Callback stops at the treeline — pacing, unwilling. The walls end the argument. It's still out there.

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: ⚔ AD BREAK! You're on your own.

w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📖 Codex: Rerun — locks onto one target — moving won't dodge it. You won't forget this.

stripes flowing where no wind blows is hurt — and it goes quiet and clever. It stops rushing. It starts CHOOSING. Watch the spacing.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Flashbulb Moth is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
🛡️ Irving, Onni and Nikolai met them at the door — 3 put down. Irving, Onni, Nikolai are hurt.

⚠ WARNING: reserves critical. Eat tomorrow or the spiral begins.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — regional standing, waves 1–3 faced (11/7/7), 12 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices.
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; promises kept. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE WITNESS — "Offer them a way back."
◈ THE ARCHITECT — Yara Haddad ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.
